brand = "Indian Roller (IRI)"

certification = "ISO 9001:2008"
headquarters = "Sahibabad, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, India"

[description]
Indian Roller Industries (IRI) is a leading manufacturer of industrial rubber rollers, polyurethane rollers, and precision-engineered roller solutions for multiple industrial sectors including steel, textile, food processing, paper & packaging, plywood, cement, and conveyor systems. The company operates advanced manufacturing facilities across India and Bangladesh.
